project: Weather Forecasting and Avatar Styling App

requirements.description: A new user signs up with an e-mail address and logs in with the 4-digit code sent to it; no passwords are stored.
requirements.acceptance: The code arrives by e-mail within one minute; entering it within 10 minutes logs the user in; an expired or wrong code is refused with a message.

requirements.description: The app displays the weather forecast for the user's selected location for the current day and the next day.
requirements.acceptance: Select a location and open the weather screen; the current and next day's temperature, weather condition, and precipitation information are displayed.

requirements.description: The app recommends suitable clothing and accessories based on the forecast.
requirements.acceptance: When the forecast includes rain or low temperature, the app displays relevant recommendations such as an umbrella, jacket, or hoodie.

requirements.description: The user can customize an avatar by selecting hair, makeup, clothing, and other available appearance options.
requirements.acceptance: Open the avatar editor and select different hair, makeup, and clothing options; the selected items appear on the avatar.

requirements.description: The user can change the avatar's body size and choose from available male and female avatar options.
requirements.acceptance: Open the avatar customization screen, select an available avatar type, and change its size; the avatar updates to show the selected appearance.

requirements.description: Every screen is usable on a phone about 390 px wide without horizontal scrolling.
requirements.acceptance: Every screen opened on a 390 px wide phone or browser phone view has no horizontal scroll bar, no text cut off, and every button is reachable.

requirements.description: The app sends alerts when severe weather or potentially dangerous natural weather events are expected.
requirements.acceptance: When severe weather data is available for the selected location, the app displays an alert describing the event and the recommended safety action.

requirements.description: The app loads the weather forecast and recommendations within 3 seconds under normal network conditions.
requirements.acceptance: Measure the time from opening the weather screen to displaying the forecast and recommendations under a normal network connection; the information appears within 3 seconds.

requirements.description: The app uses readable text and clearly identifiable buttons and controls so that users can easily understand and interact with the interface.
requirements.acceptance: All important text is readable, buttons and controls are clearly distinguishable, and users can identify the purpose of each main action without confusion.

requirements.description: The chatbot helps users answer questions about the weather and gives simple suggestions about suitable outfits based on the weather conditions.
requirements.acceptance: Only logged-in users can use the chatbot. It answers questions about the weather and provides outfit recommendations using only the user's own data. Each user can send a maximum of 20 messages per day.
